summary.zh: 写 React 组件并优化性能与包体积
summary.en: Build and review React, Next.js and Tailwind frontends

description.zh: 开发 React、Next.js、TypeScript 与 Tailwind 前端：写组件、搭页面、优化渲染性能和打包体积。适合新建组件或应用、页面卡顿、包体积过大，或需要一次前端代码评审时使用。
description.en: Builds and reviews React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind frontends: new components and pages, rendering performance, bundle size. Use it when a page feels slow or the bundle keeps growing.
